//: Library manifest for the PPSSPP web front end.
IMPORTANT: this host serves NO game images. Nothing here is a playable file --
every entry describes a game and where its images come from, and the user
supplies their own copy.
Two fields per entry:
source        - the collection page. Download goes to sourceFile when
present, otherwise to source with a Text Fragment.
sourceFile    - exact filename within that collection. Download points
straight at it, so one click lands on the file itself.
sourceText    - same filename, kept as data for the listing fallback.
files         - for multi-file ('directory game') layouts, the member names
expected inside the user's supplied folder.
Adding a copy: the user drags the file onto the tile, or presses Play and
picks it. It is read into memory for that session and discarded afterwards.
NOTHING IS STORED -- not on this server and not in the browser. An earlier
version cached the picked image in OPFS, which meant the browser quietly held
hundreds of megabytes with no obvious way to see or reclaim it. Playing
straight from the file the user already has costs them nothing.
Consequence: the file must be picked again after a reload. That is the
deliberate trade.
